description: This PHP source file defines the SpotsController class, which manages data retrieval and caching for various CRM modules such as Accounts, Leads, Opportunities, Cases, Calls, Meetings, Tasks, Campaigns, and Quotes within the SuiteCRM platform. It includes methods for generating JSON data files for these modules, handling database queries with support for MySQL and MSSQL, and ensuring data freshness based on a stale time threshold.

classes.name: SpotsController
classes.description: Controller class for managing cached data retrieval for CRM modules, supporting database abstraction and access control.

methods.description: Returns the type of database in use ('mysql', 'mssql', or 'undefined').

methods.description: Builds an access control WHERE clause for a given module and alias, based on user permissions.
